method: Independent full-matrix oracle vs JavaScript transcriptions of the pinned article pseudocode; code-point units; deterministic binary strings length 0–5 and seven explicit cases. No runtime performance claim.
finding: Dense Ukkonen reference pseudocode resets all n+1 entries for each processed row. Correctness tests do not establish O(k min(m,n)) total running time; full-row initialization makes worst-case total work quadratic in lengths even when k is small. Article already acknowledges compact storage / boundary resetting in section 58. Clarify this specific listing and provide a tested band-only alternative before claiming complexity.
